tactics: have key : ∀ l : List { x // p x }, (List.filter f l).unattach = List.filter g l.unattach := by intro l; induction l with | nil => simp | cons a t ih => cases a with | mk x hx => by_cases hg : g x = true <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons]

have key : ∀ l : List { x // p x }, (List.filter f l).unattach = List.filter g l.unattach := by intro l; induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a t ih => obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a; simp only [List.filter_cons, hf, List.unattach_cons]; split <;> simp_all
